scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && esbuild src/renderer/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/index.js --format=iife && copy src\renderer\*.html dist\renderer\ && copy src\renderer\*.css dist\renderer\ && copy node_modules\@xterm\xterm\css\xterm.css dist\renderer\ && if not exist dist\vs xcopy /s /i /y /q node_modules\monaco-editor\min\vs dist\vs >nul
scripts.dev:watch: concurrently -k "tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --watch" "esbuild src/renderer/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/index.js --format=iife --watch" "copy src\renderer\*.html dist\renderer\ && copy src\renderer\*.css dist\renderer\ && npx wait-on dist/main/main.js && copyfiles -u 1 node_modules\@xterm\xterm\css\xterm.css dist\renderer\ && if not exist dist\vs xcopy /s /q node_modules\monaco-editor\min\vs dist\vs >nul"
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run generate-assets && electron-builder
scripts.pack:win: npm run build && npm run generate-assets && electron-builder --win
scripts.pack:mac: npm run build && npm run generate-assets && electron-builder --mac
scripts.pack:linux: npm run build && npm run generate-assets && electron-builder --linux
